question: CLO3: air conditioning / ECS / cooling pack / air cycle machine / bleed air in Farokhi and El-Sayed (slide Ch.3 tr.29-36 = "Air conditioner in aircraft", "AIR CYCLE COOLING PACK", "Operation of the Cooling Pack")

farokhi.note: No hit for air conditioning, ECS, cooling pack, air cycle, customer bleed, cabin, refrigeration. The only hits are rocket propellant tank pressurization (Ch.12), turbine-cooling bleed and inlet boundary-layer bleed (not cabin air). So: không có.

hits.text: Comment on a bleed ratio: "bleeding has its applications for cabin-air conditioning as well as other anti-icing functions." (turbofan Ch.5, outside the scope chapters; the sentence names the use, no ECS description, no air-cycle machine, no cooling pack)
history: "enclosed cabin airplane became the standard" (no ECS)
"Engine noise in the cabin area is reduced" (propfan; no ECS)

elsayed.note: Turbine-cooling bleed (Ch.5 Examples, Ch.14) and bleed valves of compressors (Ch.13) are not air-conditioning content.

conclusion: Neither book describes the aircraft ECS / air cycle machine / cooling pack. Best textbook anchors for CLO3 stay Cengel Ch.11 (esp. §11-8 gas refrigeration = reversed Brayton) and Ch.14 §14-7 (air-conditioning processes); the cooling-pack slides tr.29-36 have no book counterpart.
